source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 601 and PDF pages 19-20 Civil Service Annuity Deduction, with its examples; Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 30,000.00 + federal civil service annuity person 0 12,000.00 = 42,000.00. Federal taxable income = 42,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 26,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 42,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 42,000.00 + 0.00 = 42,000.00. Civil service annuity person 0 (age 63): cap 16,000.00 less that person's own Social Security received 0.00 and railroad retirement 0.00 = 16,000.00; lesser of the annuity 12,000.00 and 16,000.00 = 12,000.00. Schedule 2: line 11 code 601 civil service annuity 12,000.00; line 12 total = 12,000.00. IT-40 line 4 = 12,000.00. Line 5 = 42,000.00 - 12,000.00 = 30,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 1,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 1,000.00. Line 7 = 30,000.00 - 1,000.00 = 29,000.00. Line 8 = 29,000.00 x 0.03 = 870.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 870.00. No Social Security or railroad income, so booklet and projection agree: the whole annuity.
